zh: 组件库浮窗不再被别的插件给所有对话窗定的尺寸框住：它不再声明 `dialog` 这个角色，高度上限仍按与下方菜单的间距算，题头与关闭钮不会再被推到窗口上缘之外。
en: The widget library no longer takes the size another plugin gives every dialog: it no longer declares the dialog role, so its own cap — the space above the menu — keeps the header and close button inside the window.
